title: docs(spec): ISecurityService and the data-engine contract page state the ADR-0096 D5 refusal of a principal-less context
body:
Fixes #22302
Clause-②: no

## Summary

ADR-0096 D5 strict mode (merged as a3bcbcf3ca) made `plugin-security` refuse a data-engine context that carries no principal and is not a system context. Two published texts still taught the old hand-off, and this PR corrects them. Text only: no shape, runtime or export moves.

- `packages/spec/src/contracts/security-service.ts`: the four sentences the card names, at three methods. Each now states what that context gets, in the words of the method's return, and cites ADR-0096 D5.
- `content/docs/kernel/contracts/data-engine.mdx`: the `ExecutionContext` passage no longer teaches `{ flowRunId }` alone as an admitted context. It names the two admitted contexts and the refusal.
- `.changeset/22302-security-service-principal-less-text.md`: `@objectstack/spec` patch (the TSDoc ships in the published `.d.ts`).

## What each sentence says now

A "principal" is what the existing text already defines: a position, a named permission set or a user id. The context in question has none of the three and is not `isSystem`.

| Where | Before | After |
|:---|:---|:---|
| `getReadFilter`, deny baseline paragraph | only a context with no principal at all keeps the scope the other layers compose, "ADR-0096 stages that context separately" | so does a non-system context with no principal at all (ADR-0096 D5 strict mode): the DENY filter, before any layer composes a scope, as the engine middleware's principal-less refusal (`403 PERMISSION_DENIED`) answers the same context |
| `canExport`, fails-closed paragraph | only a context with no principal at all is admitted, as the middleware hands it through | so does a non-system context with no principal at all (ADR-0096 D5 strict mode): `false` before anything resolves, the answer the middleware's principal-less refusal (`403 PERMISSION_DENIED`) gives it |
| `canReadObject`, arm list | the deny baseline arm, with "only a context that carries no principal at all is handed through" in parentheses | a new arm after `isSystem`: the ADR-0096 D5 refusal of a context with no principal at all (`false`, before anything resolves); the ADR-0056 D2 arm keeps its wording |
| `canReadObject`, fails-closed paragraph | only a context with no principal at all is admitted, as the middleware hands it through | same sentence as `canExport` |
| `data-engine.mdx`, `ExecutionContext` passage | a run with no resolvable identity passes only `{ flowRunId }`, a context that deliberately carries no principal | what the engine needs is a principal or an explicit elevation: the caller's own context, or `{ isSystem: true }`. A context with neither is refused by the security plugin with `403 PERMISSION_DENIED` before the operation runs, for every verb. `{ flowRunId }` alone is such a context: a run id is provenance, not identity |

Unchanged on purpose: the system bypass sentences, the ADR-0056 D2 deny baseline for a caller that carries a principal and resolves no set, and the `getReadableFields` paragraph (it already says "a non-system caller who resolves no permission set", which a principal-less context now is). No PR number or tracker id is cited in the shipped text.

## Hypotheses measured before writing

Measured against origin/main at fe98cc63a (the tree moved after the base 59d993c97; the moved files do not touch principal-less handling, checked by diff of `security-plugin.ts`, which changed only in the organization-wall region).

- **H1 holds. No mode switch.** `isPrincipalLessContext(context)` is read at five call sites in `security-plugin.ts`: the engine middleware (throws `principalLessDenial`, a `PermissionDeniedError`, `403 PERMISSION_DENIED`, for every verb, after the `isSystem` bypass, the public-form-grant branch and the pre-resolution gates, and before any permission-set resolution), `getReadFilter` (returns the deny filter), `canReadObject`, `canWriteObject` and `canExport` (each returns `false`). The sixth site, `resolveProjectionFieldMask`, no longer settles a principal-less context early: it falls through to the zero-set mask like any caller that resolves no set. `SecurityPluginOptions` has two keys (`defaultPermissionSets`, `fallbackPermissionSet`) and the file reads no environment variable on this path. `principal-less-strict-mode.test.ts`, `can-read-object-admission.test.ts` and `can-write-object-admission.test.ts` pass (3 files, 103 tests).
- **H2: the file holds exactly the four sentences, and no `canWriteObject` passage.** `canWriteObject` is not a member of `ISecurityService` (it is a method of the plugin only), so the contract file never describes it. The other `principal` hits in the file were each read: `hasWriteBypass` (:698), `resolveWriteScope` (:718), `describeDelegationNarrowing` (:754) and `checkAuthoredRowWrite` (:798) say a principal-less context fails closed, answers `narrowed: false` or abstains, all still true. `getMetadataReadableFields` (:389) says `canReadObject` is "the deny baseline for a caller that carries a principal", which is true and incomplete, not a hand-off statement, and is left alone.
- **H3 holds for `content/docs`.** `data-engine.mdx` is the only page that teaches `{ flowRunId }` as an admitted context. The other `flowRunId` and "no principal" hits are auto-generated reference tables or are about other subjects (record-view auditing, the time-triggered flow acting organization, realtime subscriptions, rate-limit keys). One neighbouring sentence is named under Acceptance notes.

## Verification

All on commit 4363c583d (the head of this branch).

- Gates: `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derived 101 commands (95 at dispatch, plus 6 that apply once the changeset exists). 100 ran with exit 0. 1 is NOT MEASURED: `pnpm check:dual-build-cjs-loads` exited 3, PREREQUISITE NOT MET (it reads `dist/` of 32 packages and needs a repo-wide `pnpm build`; nothing was measured). Basis for leaving it to CI (`Build Core`): this diff emits no JavaScript. The new sentences appear only in `packages/spec/dist/contracts/index.d.ts` and `index.d.mts`; a recursive grep of `dist/` finds them in no `.js` or `.cjs`, and finds none of the old sentences anywhere. Three gates first exited 3 for unbuilt prerequisites (`@objectstack/formula`, `@objectstack/lint`, `@objectstack/client-react`); after building those they ran and exited 0.
- `--ran` verdict line: `dispatch-gates --ran: 101 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 100 run, 1 NOT-MEASURED (1 DERIVED from a recorded exit 3).` Exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec build` exit 0. `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec typecheck` exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/contracts/security-service.test.ts src/contracts/core-service-contracts.test.ts`: 2 files, 33 tests passed.
- Reverse verification and ablation do not apply: no behaviour moves, so there is no assertion to turn red.
- Not run here, left to CI: the repo-wide lint run, `Test Core`, `Dogfood Regression Gate`, `Build Docs` and the type-check lanes outside `@objectstack/spec`.

## Line budget

59 changed lines against the merge base (42 added, 17 removed) in 3 files. No governed path is touched (`docs/adr/**`, `skills/**`, `.claude/**`, `AGENTS.md`, `CLAUDE.md`: 0).

## Acceptance notes

Noted, not edited, because they sit outside the two files the claim names. They state the same hand-off in published or shipped text and are worth one follow-up edit together:

- `packages/spec/src/kernel/execution-context.zod.ts`, the `flowRunId` field TSDoc (about :336-341): "A run that resolves no principal ... passes exactly `{ flowRunId }`: ... such a context authorizes identically to no context at all, and the run keeps the unscoped posture it already had". Stale: that context is refused now.
- `packages/spec/src/kernel/execution-context.zod.ts` about :499-501, the `ExecutionContext` type TSDoc: "a flow run with no resolvable identity passes provenance alone (`{ flowRunId }`)". Teaches the refused context as a valid one.
- `packages/spec/src/data/data-engine.zod.ts` about :66-71, the `BaseEngineOptionsSchema.context` TSDoc: "a flow run that resolves no identity passes provenance alone (`{ flowRunId }`), a context deliberately carrying no principal at all". Same.
- `packages/spec/src/contracts/analytics-service.ts` about :441-443: the rationale for forwarding the request context says a context-less bridge ran "completely unscoped" because "the security middleware's fall-open skipped its own RLS injection". Historical, but with `plugin-security` composed the context-less call is refused rather than unscoped.
- `content/docs/permissions/access-recipes.mdx` :52: "A schedule-triggered run has no user, so under `user` it runs unscoped". The `runAs` text in `content/docs/automation/approvals.mdx`, `hooks.mdx` and the generated `automation-api.mdx` says such a run's data operations are refused. I did not run a schedule-triggered flow, so this is a read-only inference.
- `hook.zod.ts` about :1126 ("a schedule-triggered flow run resolves no principal") reads true as written and is left alone.

One behaviour edge, measured by reading and by `principal-less-strict-mode.test.ts`, not a text defect: the middleware's public-form-grant branch (ADR-0056) sits ahead of the principal-less refusal, so a hand-built `{ publicFormGrant: { object } }` with no named set would be admitted for its create and read-back on that object, while `canReadObject`, `canExport` and `getReadFilter` answer deny for it. The only producer in the tree, the REST form-submit route, builds its context with `permissions: ['guest_portal']`, so it carries a principal and is not in the class this text describes. The new text says "the middleware's principal-less refusal" rather than claiming the middleware refuses every such context for that reason.


## Patch round 1 (the seat amended the claim surface)

Adds the TSDoc of two more published sources and one docs line. Comment and docs text only: 0 of 71 changed lines in the three .ts files is outside a comment block.

- packages/spec/src/kernel/execution-context.zod.ts: the flowRunId field TSDoc and the ExecutionContext input type TSDoc. packages/spec/src/data/data-engine.zod.ts: the BaseEngineOptionsSchema.context TSDoc. They no longer say a run with no principal passes exactly the flowRunId-only context, which authorizes like no context and keeps the unscoped posture, or that such a context is deliberately principal-less. They now say a non-system context with no principal is refused with 403 PERMISSION_DENIED (ADR-0096 D5), that a run id is provenance and not a principal, and, for the flowRunId field, what the automation engine really hands the engine.
- content/docs/permissions/access-recipes.mdx line 52: a schedule-triggered run under runAs user is refused, not run unscoped.
- The changeset gains one sentence naming the three passages (still @objectstack/spec patch, Clause-② no).

Measured before written, on origin/main at 28bff18d0 (the merge base of this round): packages/services/service-automation/src/runtime-identity.ts, resolveRunDataContext (line 178). With runAs system it returns isSystem true plus actor svc:flow:NAME, empty positions and permissions, the run id, and the trigger userId and tenantId only when the trigger resolved them (lines 180-218). With runAs user and no trigger user, which is what a schedule run has, it throws UnscopedRunDataAccessError (code AUTOMATION_UNSCOPED_RUN_DATA_ACCESS) at line 231, before any call reaches the data engine. With a trigger user it returns that user identity (line 233 on). engine.ts resolveRunContext (lines 6057 and 6062) stamps runAs (default user) and flowRunId on the run context. Nothing in service-automation builds a flowRunId-only context: the RunProvenanceContext type is exported but produced nowhere. Pinned by src/builtin/crud-runas.test.ts (24 tests pass; lines 221, 247, 288 and 316: a user-mode run with no user throws, a schedule run reaches the data layer with zero operations and fails, a record-change run fired by a user-less write is refused the same way).

Verification on head b7cc3e217: spec build exit 0; the old sentences are in no file of packages/spec/dist (.d.ts, .d.mts, .js, .mjs: 0 files); the type TSDoc lands in manifest.zod-*.d.ts and .d.mts, the field TSDoc in the kernel, data, api and browser JS bundles only (a field comment is not emitted into a declaration); spec typecheck exit 0; check:docs exit 0; dispatch-gates --ran: 102 derived, 101 run, 1 NOT-MEASURED (check:dual-build-cjs-loads, exit 3 PREREQUISITE NOT MET, needs a repo-wide build, left to Build Core). Line budget against the merge base: 101 changed lines (68 added, 33 removed), 6 files, 0 governed paths. This round the comments do ship in JS bundles, so the round-0 statement that the diff emits no JavaScript no longer holds; the gate stays NOT MEASURED on the basis that every changed line in the three .ts files is a comment line.

Acceptance notes added: (1) skills/objectstack-query/SKILL.md line 66 still reads that flowRunId is passed for provenance alone; it is a governed Tier H file, not edited, needs its own carrier. (2) packages/services/service-automation/src/runtime-identity.ts lines 56-81 and engine.ts lines 6042-6046 still describe the pre-refusal middleware skip, and the RunProvenanceContext export has no producer; noted, not edited, carrier none. (3) contracts/analytics-service.ts about line 441 stays, as the seat ruled: past-tense history.

CI note, not caused by a test: Test Core 6 of 6 fails at the step Check this shard timing drift (exit 1) on this PR at both 4363c583d and b7cc3e217, with the shard test step before it passing; the same shard is green on the current origin/main push run. The job log is not reachable from this container (the log blob host is refused), so the drift numbers are NOT MEASURED here.

- **No sentence went false.** `main` touched none of the six paths, and #22357 / #22382 restate the same principal-less rule in agreement.
